title: Scarborough Fair / Whittingham Fair — Complete Traditional Tune (1882)
description: Complete eight-bar 1882 Whittingham Fair melody, played through three times with an original four-bar introduction and coda. Historically related to Scarborough Fair, but NOT the Simon & Garfunkel / Martin Carthy recording arrangement.
body: 6/8 instrumental programme: Intro: [Em] [C] [D] [Em] | Traditional 8-bar tune × 3 | Coda: [Em] [C] [D] [Em]. Traditional air transcribed in E minor, no lyrics.
notes: Source: Bruce & Stokoe, Northumbrian Minstrelsy (1882), pp. 81–82; historical ABC preserved by The Fiddler's Companion, https://www.ibiblio.org/fiddlers/WHI_WHZ.htm (Whittingham Fair). Melody kept in E minor, 6/8, with the source's eight-bar pitches and rhythms repeated without alteration. New ukulele-specific introduction, coda, harmony and fingerings. Four-string high-G GCEA, no capo. Verse 1 bars 5–12; verse 2 bars 13–20; verse 3 bars 21–28; intro bars 1–4; coda bars 29–32. This is NOT a transcription of the 1966 Simon & Garfunkel recording, its counterpoint or its guitar arrangement.
